posts.title: Observability in Go: What Goes in a Metric, a Log, and a Trace
posts.description: What actually holds up when you build observability into a Go service: what belongs in a metric vs a log vs a trace, a measured cost of getting that wrong, dashboards and alerting that don't cause fatigue, and PII discipline - not another setup tutorial.

posts.title: Cutting JSON Parsing CPU Cost in Go
posts.description: encoding/json, jsoniter, easyjson, sonic, and Go 1.27's encoding/json/v2 benchmarked head to head on the same payload, on both Apple M5 and an x86 VPS - reproducible numbers, not vendor claims.

posts.title: SQL vs NoSQL vs Columnar: Choosing the Right Database for Your Go Service
posts.description: Comparison of PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, and ClickHouse. Performance metrics, cost analysis, and when to use each.
